_rascunho: Draft translation of the Portuguese text (pt.json is the final one).
chamada: ENEM and university entrance exam dates, each with its official source, and tutoring booked by subject and time.
entre: The study calendar is for people on Alumia. Sign in to follow dates and book tutoring.

provas.vazio: Coordination and mediation write the dates here, always with the official source. Check back soon.
provas.vazioCuida: Write the first date in the card on the side, or bring in the ENEM dates the site already has.
provas.suasNenhuma: You haven't asked for a reminder on any date yet. Tap “Remind me” on the ones you want.
provas.suasUma: You asked for a reminder on 1 date.
provas.suas: You asked for reminders on {n} dates.
regra: The reminder arrives 7 days before and the day before, between 9am and 9pm.
If a date changes or leaves the calendar, the notice arrives right away, with the source.
Alumia only keeps that you asked for a reminder on that date, and erases it after the day.
The calendar file is made on your device: nothing goes to another service.
provas.deixou: You will no longer get reminders for this date.
provas.assinou: Done: we'll remind you 7 days before and the day before “{etapa}”.

cuidar.texto: Only dates with an official source go in: the notice, the agency page or the Official Gazette. Whoever asked for reminders hears about every change.
cuidar.regraDaFonte: Only addresses starting with https://. The same exam, stage and day don't repeat: writing again updates the source.
cuidar.trocada: Date changed. If the day or time changed, people with reminders were notified.
cuidar.tirarTitulo: Remove this date from the calendar?
cuidar.tirarTexto: “{etapa}” ({exame}) leaves the calendar, and people with reminders are told it was removed.
cuidar.doSite: The site has {n} upcoming ENEM dates, with the Inep source. Bring them in without rewriting (what's already there won't be duplicated).
cuidar.doSite1: The site has 1 upcoming ENEM date, with the Inep source. Bring it in without rewriting (what's already there won't be duplicated).
cuidar.trazer: Bring in the site's ENEM dates
cuidar.trazidas: {n} ENEM dates checked in the calendar.

monitoria.lado: Offering times and how tutoring works
monitoria.abertasTexto: You choose the subject and the time. The tutor shows up after you book.
monitoria.vazio: Tutors open times during the week. Come back later, or ask for help in the subject's community.
monitoria.quemVe: Only the tutor sees that you booked and your question. Both of you get a notice, and a reminder one hour before.
monitoria.marcou: Booked. You and the tutor got a notice.
monitoria.desmarcarTexto: The spot goes back to whoever needs it, and the tutor gets a notice.
monitoria.tirarDaListaTexto: This time was cancelled by the tutor. It leaves your list.
monitoria.minhasVazio: You haven't offered a time yet. Use the card on the side.
monitoria.cancelarTexto: Whoever booked gets a notice that the tutoring was cancelled.
monitoria.cancelou: Time cancelled. Whoever booked was notified.
monitoria.conviteTexto: Coordination or mediation invited you to tutor {disciplinas}. Students choose the subject and time; you only appear to whoever books.
monitoria.aceitou: Done: you can now offer times.
regra: You choose the subject and the time, never the person.
Tutors were invited by coordination or mediation and accepted.
After booking, only the two of you see each other. Nobody else knows who booked.
The room is an Alumia conversation or the site's live class. A reminder one hour before, for both.
One day after the time, the booking and the question are erased.

oferecer.texto: From 1 hour to 60 days ahead. Students see the subject, day and time, without your name.
oferecer.salaAula: In one of my live classes
oferecer.semAula: To use a live class, first schedule one in the site's panel.
oferecer.deixarTexto: Your upcoming times are cancelled, with a notice to whoever booked.

monitores.texto: Invite by @. The person accepts or declines. This list only shows for coordination, vice-coordination and mediation.
monitores.tirarTexto: Upcoming times are cancelled, with a notice to whoever booked.
monitores.tirou: Done. Whoever had booked was notified.

erros.sem_vaga: That time just filled up. Choose another.
erros.ja_comecou: That time is about to start. Choose another.
erros.limite_de_marcas: You already have 3 upcoming bookings. Cancel one to book another.
erros.limite_de_assinaturas: You already have reminders on 60 dates. Remove one to add another.
erros.invalido:fonte: The source must be a full official address starting with https://.
erros.invalido:conferido_em: The day the source was checked can't be in the future.
erros.invalido:exame: The exam name needs 2 to 60 characters.
erros.invalido:repetida: That exam, stage and day are already in the calendar.
erros.invalido:inicio: Pick a time from 1 hour to 60 days ahead.
erros.invalido:aula: Pick one of your live classes that hasn't ended.
erros.sem_permissao: This is only for whoever looks after the calendar or tutors.
erros.nao_encontrado: We couldn't find that. It may have just been removed.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many tries in a row. Wait a bit and try again.
erros.alumia_entrada: Your account is still waiting for Alumia approval.
erros.sem_servico: Alumia is offline right now. Try again shortly.
erros.generico: That didn't work right now. Try again.
